strategy_catalog.name: Enlarged Tile Sizes - Minimal
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Increase BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, and BASE_K from 64 to 128. Larger tile sizes amortize loop overhead, improve L0A/L0B utilization from 25% to 50%, and reduce the number of Mmad iterations per tile.

constraints: BLOCK_M must be multiple of C0 (=16 for fp16)
BLOCK_N must be multiple of C0
BASE_K must be multiple of C0
